name: Sky Dollar
oneLiner: USDS is Sky's upgraded successor to DAI, minted 1:1 from DAI or against the same Maker vault system of RWA, USDC, and crypto collateral.
collateral: RWA (U.S. Treasuries ~40%), USDC via PSM (~30%), crypto (ETH/wstETH ~20%), other vaults; USDS is the upgraded DAI (1:1 swap), same vault system
pegMechanism: Peg Stability Modules enabling 1:1 swaps with USDC and DAI

oracleRisk.summary: Sky/Maker collateral prices use whitelisted feed medianizers and Oracle Security Module delays before prices reach the core accounting system; governance can still alter oracle authorization and parameters.

genius.notes: Sky documents protocol conversion routes rather than a legal PPSI issuer or direct fiat redemption path. Sky Frontier Foundation explicitly disclaims issuing, custodying, redeeming, or managing reserves for USDS. No PPSI application, state-qualified pathway, or foreign-exception status has been announced as of 2026-06-07.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act proposed rule and public releases
Public U.S. permitted-issuer, state-qualified, official-application, and foreign-exception materials
Sky Frontier Foundation press releases (2026) — explicitly disclaim issuer role
Web search for Sky/USDS GENIUS Act application or PPSI compliance plan (2026)
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Sky documents protocol conversion routes but no legal PPSI issuer entity has emerged; Sky Frontier Foundation explicitly disclaims issuing or managing USDS. No GENIUS authorization, state-qualified approval, official application, or foreign exception status was located for USDS as of 2026-06-07.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: USDS ERC-20 supply is minted through USDS_JOIN against Vat.dai balances, while Sky governance/Pause Proxy remains authorized to change system modules, parameters, and USDS permissions.

controls.label: USDS_JOIN token adapter
controls.capDescription: Mints ERC-20 USDS only against existing Vat.dai balance; not an unrestricted off-protocol minter.
controls.evidence: Sky Chainlog lists USDS_JOIN at this address. USDS.wards(USDS_JOIN) returned 1 at Ethereum block 25294731. eth_getCode confirms contract bytecode present.

controls.label: Sky Pause Proxy governance executor
controls.capDescription: Sky governance executes through the Pause Proxy after the current 2-day Pause delay and can change system modules, parameters, and USDS authorizations.
controls.evidence: USDS.wards(MCD_PAUSE_PROXY) returned 1 at Ethereum block 25294731. MCD_PAUSE (0xbE286431454714F511008713973d3B053A2d38f3) storage slot 4 = 172800 (delay confirmed). eth_getCode confirms contract bytecode on both addresses.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294731: USDS.wards(USDS_JOIN=0x3C0f895007CA717Aa01c8693e59DF1e8C3777FEB)=1; USDS.wards(MCD_PAUSE_PROXY=0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB)=1; MCD_PAUSE.delay()=172800 (storage slot 4). Both controls are contracts with bytecode present. USDS_JOIN mints only against Vat.dai balance (cap-limited by Vat debt ceilings); Pause Proxy can authorize new modules with 2-day delay.
